title: AzureMentor monitoring
description: Live traffic, quality and cost for the AzureMentor RAG app.

panels.title: Questions asked

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS questions FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS questions FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000

panels.description: Total questions answered in the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_seconds), 2) AS seconds FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_seconds), 2) AS seconds FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000

panels.title: Judged relevant

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN relevance = 'RELEVANT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percent FROM conversations WHERE relevance IS NOT NULL AND created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN relevance = 'RELEVANT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percent FROM conversations WHERE relevance IS NOT NULL AND created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000

panels.description: Share of answers the LLM judge rated RELEVANT.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM conversations WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000

panels.title: Response time

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(AVG(retrieval_seconds), 3)  AS retrieval,
       ROUND(AVG(generation_seconds), 3) AS generation
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(AVG(retrieval_seconds), 3)  AS retrieval,
       ROUND(AVG(generation_seconds), 3) AS generation
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Split by stage, so a slowdown can be attributed to search or to the LLM.

panels.title: Token usage

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(AVG(prompt_tokens))     AS prompt,
       ROUND(AVG(completion_tokens)) AS completion
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(AVG(prompt_tokens))     AS prompt,
       ROUND(AVG(completion_tokens)) AS completion
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average tokens per question. Prompt tokens dominate and are driven by LLM_CONTEXT_CHUNKS.

panels.title: Cost

targets.queryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cost_usd, 0)), 6) AS cost
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(created_at_unix, 3600) AS time,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cost_usd, 0)), 6) AS cost
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Zero while the model's price is unknown. Set LLM_PRICE_INPUT_PER_1M and LLM_PRICE_OUTPUT_PER_1M in .env to populate this.

GROUP BY 1

panels.description: The LLM judge's verdict on every answer served.

targets.queryText:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN value =  1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "thumbs up",
       SUM(CASE WHEN value = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "thumbs down"
FROM feedback
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN value =  1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "thumbs up",
       SUM(CASE WHEN value = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "thumbs down"
FROM feedback
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000

targets.queryText:
SELECT created_at, question, COALESCE(relevance, 'UNJUDGED') AS relevance,
       ROUND(total_seconds, 2) AS seconds, total_tokens AS tokens,
       num_sources_cited AS cited
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
ORDER BY created_at_unix DESC
LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT created_at, question, COALESCE(relevance, 'UNJUDGED') AS relevance,
       ROUND(total_seconds, 2) AS seconds, total_tokens AS tokens,
       num_sources_cited AS cited
FROM conversations
WHERE created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
ORDER BY created_at_unix DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Judge and user disagree

targets.queryText:
SELECT c.created_at, c.question, c.relevance,
       CASE WHEN f.value = 1 THEN 'thumbs up' ELSE 'thumbs down' END AS user_vote,
       c.relevance_explanation
FROM conversations c
JOIN feedback f ON f.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE ((f.value = -1 AND c.relevance = 'RELEVANT')
    OR (f.value =  1 AND c.relevance = 'NON_RELEVANT'))
  AND c.created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
ORDER BY c.created_at_unix DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT c.created_at, c.question, c.relevance,
       CASE WHEN f.value = 1 THEN 'thumbs up' ELSE 'thumbs down' END AS user_vote,
       c.relevance_explanation
FROM conversations c
JOIN feedback f ON f.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE ((f.value = -1 AND c.relevance = 'RELEVANT')
    OR (f.value =  1 AND c.relevance = 'NON_RELEVANT'))
  AND c.created_at_unix BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
ORDER BY c.created_at_unix DESC

panels.description: Answers the judge liked but users did not, and the reverse. This is where prompt problems surface.
